description_en: Query all IP address information in the connection address pool
description_zh: 查询连接地址池所有IP地址信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-connection-pool-all-ips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --connection-pool-id cp-bp11234abctmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConnectionPoolAllIps

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
Do not specify this parameter for the first query or when there is no subsequent query.
If there is a subsequent query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page during a paginated query. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default Value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The Region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API to obtain the Region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud connector
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the connection address pool to query
parameters.name: connection_pool_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address in the connection address pool
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The type of IP address in the connection address pool. Valid values:

Cidr: The CIDR block to which the connection address pool belongs.

Host: The IP address of the Internet of Things SIM card
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址池中IP地址类型。取值：

Cidr：连接地址池所属的CIDR地址块。

Host：物联网卡的IP地址
parameters.name: type

ConnectionPoolIps.description_en: List of IP addresses in the connection address pool

items.description_en: List of IP addresses in the connection address pool

Ip.description_en: IP address in the connection address pool

IpNum.description_en:
Available IP address count.
When Type is Host, the available IP address count is 1.
When Type is Cidr, the available IP address count is the total number of IP addresses in the CIDR block
IpNum.description_zh:
可用IP数量。
Type取值为Host时，可用IP数量为1。

Type取值为Cidr时，可用IP数量为CIDR地址块的IP总数

Status.description_en: IP address status. Only activated is returned, indicating that the IP address has been activated and successfully attached to a cloud connector
Status.description_zh: IP地址状态，仅返回activated，表示已激活，IP地址和云连接器绑定完成

Type.description_en:
Type of IP address in the connection address pool. Valid values:
Cidr: The CIDR block to which the connection address pool belongs.
Host: IP address of an Internet of Things (IoT) card
Type.description_zh:
连接地址池中IP地址类型。取值：

Cidr：连接地址池所属的CIDR地址块。

Host：物联网卡的IP地址

MaxResults.description_en: Number of entries displayed per batch during paginated queries
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, there is no subsequent query.
If NextToken has a return value, this value represents the token to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalIpsCount.description_en: Total number of entries in the list
